CoreRun / Why I’m building it +

The problem: consistency is hard when training, habits, and reflection live in different places.

The product: a daily dashboard that brings habits, a journal, progress, and community into one mobile experience.

My perspective: building from the intersection of mobile engineering and my own endurance practice.

TagVault / From physical things to digital order +

The problem: remembering which container holds an item shouldn’t be another system to maintain in your head.

The build: a mobile vault with containers, documents, QR scanning, and NFC tags.

The craft: connecting camera and device interactions to a simple, useful organization model.
